name: plan-flow
description: Shows what a Claude Code session is doing: each request you sent with what came of it and what is left, above the prompt, and the whole list in a side drawer (/flow).

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band, drawer and toasts; auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale, then English

autoShow.title: Show the board on its own
autoShow.description: Show the board above the prompt as soon as the first request is sent; off shows it only after /flow

enabled.title: Run in new sessions
enabled.description: Run plan-flow in each new session; off, a session starts with no board and no model calls until /flow on

statusBlock.title: Ask Claude for a status block
statusBlock.description: Experimental: ask Claude, through one section of its system prompt, to end each answer that followed work with a short status block that the board reads; off adds nothing to what Claude reads
